mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 1.0% per annum signals a tightening monetary policy regime that raises discount rates on equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 1.0, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the mean return in low-unemployment periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.1 million units signals strong household demand and confidence, which drives higher equity valuations via improved corporate revenue expectations and positive forward S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances where HOUST > 1100.0, or the average return in high-housing periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 104.0 index level signals weakening manufacturing activity and economic contraction, which triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the mean return in low-industrial periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL above 245.0 and FEDFUNDS above 1.0% signals persistent inflation and a restrictive monetary policy, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 40% of instances where both CPIAUCSL > 245.0 and FEDFUNDS > 1.0, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 485,000 million dollars, combined with rising industrial production, signals strong aggregate demand that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in less than 40% of instances where RSAFS > 485000.0 and INDPRO > 104.0, or the joint signal is not significant (p > 0.05 in interaction model).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 145,000 jobs per month, combined with a declining unemployment rate, signals a labor market that is both expanding and tightening, which increases inflationary pressure and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances where PAYEMS > 145000.0 and UNRATE < 4.2, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: An ongoing expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) at a quarterly rate above 2.0%, combined with rising residential construction, signals a strong economic expansion that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 40% of instances where GDPC1 > 17150.0 and HOUST > 1100.0, or the joint signal is not significant (p > 0.05 in interaction model).
